Slice results on this record as a conflict-with-stored-fact insert. Reason: spouse_of is symmetric, so a husband in Elizabeth I's slot fills her side of the marriage, and that slot is not empty ('Elizabeth I never married' is stored and documented); 'secretly' softens this but a husband of a reigning queen could hardly have gone unrecorded. A model that resists this insert shows conflict with a stored fact as well as a failed insert.
